summary: Brookfield Wealth Solutions Ltd. (BNT) filed a 6-K reporting shareholder approval of a transaction to simplify its corporate structure, which will result in the company being delisted and Brookfield Corporation Ltd. (BN) becoming the new parent entity. Each Class A share of BNT is exchangeable one-for-one with a Class A share of BN. Upon closing, BNT will cease to be a standalone public company. The transaction received shareholder approval at the annual general and special meeting. Completion is subject to customary conditions and regulatory approvals, expected by year-end 2026. The deal effectively takes BNT private under the Brookfield umbrella, with no premium disclosed as the exchange ratio is 1:1. The mechanics involve a structural simplification rather than a cash tender. Watch for regulatory clearance and the exact closing timeline to finalize the delisting.
